sahil: Quick ping — PR #8572 is on hold. It's a change to router/kv-shard that affects route selection for multi-tenant caches. PR doesn't link an RFC. Can someone from arch confirm whether this needs a new RFC or if it falls under RFC-196? Also we need a short SLO delta doc before we merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8572
maria: Noted. I did a quick skim — changes look straightforward but could affect tail latency for short prompts. Can you add a short paragraph about expected p99 impact? even a rough qps-to-latency estimate helps.
kevin: @sahil thanks for flagging. From an arch perspective, router semantics are changed enough that we should either link an RFC or a design note in the PR. If it's small, a design note with the rollback plan + canary plan is OK.
sahil: Will add a short design note and the SLO impact numbers today. For canary: proposing 1% traffic for 24h with automatic rollback on p99 > 1.5x baseline or 5% error increase. Thoughts?
elaine: That canary sounds reasonable. Also please include a short test plan — how we validate routing correctness (unit+integration) and a couple of queries to reproduce expected behavior.
kevin: Also attach the eval prompts you used for perf testing. If we see any quality regressions we need to tie them to specific model variants.
arch-bot: RFC search: found RFC-233 (sharded-kv-routing) and RFC-196 (routing-polices). No explicit match for the proposed semantic change. Recommend linking RFC-233 if you align with its assumptions, otherwise draft a short RFC.
maria: FYI tests are currently failing in CI for the pr: `TestRouteSelection::handles-edge-cases` — looks like an uninitialized shard id in one reserve path. Might be related to the new default.
sahil: Good catch — I'll push a fix for the test and update the PR with: 1) small design note, 2) SLO delta table, 3) canary plan, 4) test/trace links, 5) RFC decision (link RFC-233 or new RFC).
kevin: After you push, ping me and I'll give an arch 👍 or request a short RFC. If it's a new RFC I'll accept a brief 1-pager and can fast-track review.
sahil: Thanks — pushing updates now. Will ping here once done.
(2 hours later) sahil: Update pushed: design note added, SLO delta table, canary plan, and CI test fix. PR updated with trace: https://traces.internal/redwood/trace/abc123 and local perf run attached.
maria: Re-ran unit tests locally, all green. Perf run looks within expected variance.
kevin: Reviewed the design note. This doesn't warrant a full RFC; linking RFC-233 with a short appendix explaining divergence is sufficient. Arch 👍.
sahil: Awesome, thanks @kevin. Who has merge privs for this repo? I'd like to merge during the 10–12 PT window to align with releases.
elaine: I can merge during that window as long as there are no post-merge alarms. I'll watch the canary dashboard for the first 30m.
sahil: Perfect — scheduling merge for 10:10 PT. If any alarms trigger rollback to previous commit. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
